item.text: The first concrete cluster is now clear: update assignments evaluate their right-hand filter against the wrong input, path discovery rejects valid out-of-range creation paths, destructuring loses the outer `$name` binding, and object patterns reject quoted/computed keys. These are shared causes behind many reported failures, so I’m patching them together.
